title: Helping a Health Services Startup Show Up in AI Search
viewer: Founder, website helper, or portfolio reviewer
takeaway: This is a repeatable, evidence-backed review with clear fixes, not a claim that rankings, mentions, or sales already improved.

scenes.intent: AI search visibility was hard to see. The founder needed evidence, not generic tips.
scenes.headline: The founder needed evidence, not generic tips.

scenes.intent: The review used public evidence only. No analytics, website admin, or server access.
scenes.headline: The review used public evidence only.

scenes.intent: I tested 74 search situations. Spanish and English questions covered four major search tools.
scenes.headline: The test covered four search tools.
scenes.assetAlt: Public AI-search audit preview with tested, checked, rechecked, and fix-list counts.

scenes.intent: The checks showed where the business appeared or went missing. Thirty-three results were checked directly in the browser.
scenes.headline: Browser checks showed where visibility disappeared.
scenes.assetAlt: Public audit preview showing browser-checked evidence and findings.

scenes.intent: The findings became a private report with 9 fixes. Evidence and monthly checks keep the review reusable.
scenes.headline: The findings became an ordered fix plan.
scenes.assetAlt: Public audit preview showing the fix list and client delivery summary.
